newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill Pakistani Shi'ite activist.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill Pakistani Shi'ite activist.

text.p: Gunmen killed a Shi'ite Moslem activist in Pakistan's central province of Punjab on Sunday, police said.
Malik Ghulam Sarwar was shot by three men on motorcycles as he opened his electronics shop at Chichawatni, 200 km (125 miles) southwest of the provincial capital Lahore.
He escaped the first two rounds of automatic weapons fire and ran but was eventually hit and died instantly, the police said.

There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the attack, which police said seemed to be the latest in a series of tit-for-tat killings between rival militant groups of the majority Sunni and the minority Shi'ite Islamic branches.
More than 100 people have been killed this year in a surge of religious violence in the populous Punjab.
Sunni groups accuse the predominantly Shi'ite neighbouring Iran of financing Pakistani Shi'ite militants, while Shi'ites accuse the Sunni Saudi Arabia of aiding Sunni militants.
